title: 7 Best Herbal Tinctures For Motion Sickness
intro: Herbal tinctures for motion sickness are a natural and effective remedy made by infusing herbs in a solvent, such as alcohol or glycerin, to create a concentrated liquid extract. These tinctures have gained popularity as a treatment for motion sickness due to their benefits, including reducing nausea and vomiting, and promoting relaxation. Examples of herbal tinctures that can help alleviate motion sickness include ginger, peppermint, and lavender, which have anti-inflammatory and calming properties that can soothe the digestive system and reduce anxiety. Other herbs like ashwagandha, passionflower, and valerian root are also commonly used to treat motion sickness, as they help to regulate the nervous system and promote a sense of balance and well-being.

preparations.preparation_desc: Zingiber officinale tinctures have been traditionally used to treat motion sickness due to their anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help to alleviate nausea and vomiting associated with this ailment. The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale, including gingerols and shogaols, have been shown to have a positive effect on the digestive system, reducing the symptoms of motion sickness. By inhibiting the release of serotonin, a neurotransmitter responsible for nausea, Zingiber officinale tinctures can help to alleviate the discomfort and distress associated with motion sickness. The benefits of using Zingiber officinale tinctures to treat motion sickness include reduced nausea and vomiting, improved digestion, and a decrease in overall discomfort.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Zingiber officinale tinctures for motion sickness have been well documented and proved beyond doubt in numerous high-quality clinical studies to prevent nausea, dizziness, and vomiting.

preparations.preparation_desc: Ginkgo biloba tinctures have been traditionally used to treat motion sickness due to their anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for this effect include flavonoids, terpenoids, and bilobalide, which help to stabilize the blood vessels and improve blood flow to the inner ear, thereby reducing nausea and dizziness. Ginkgo biloba tinctures work by blocking the action of acetylcholine, a neurotransmitter involved in the vomiting reflex, and by reducing the sensitivity of the inner ear to motion. The benefits of using Ginkgo biloba tinctures to treat motion sickness include natural relief from nausea and vomiting, reduced risk of dehydration, and a sense of calm and well-being during travel.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "American journal of health-system pharmacy : AJHP : official journal of the American Society of Health-System Pharmacists", Ginkgo biloba tinctures for motion sickness are considered a potentially safe herbal therapy.

preparations.preparation_desc: Valeriana officinalis tinctures have been traditionally used to treat motion sickness due to their sedative and anti-emetic properties, which help to alleviate symptoms such as nausea and vomiting. The herbal preparation's ability to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety contributes to its effectiveness in treating motion sickness. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include valerenic acid, isovaltrate, and valepotriates, which have been shown to interact with GABA receptors and reduce the excitability of the nervous system. Regular use of Valeriana officinalis tinctures may help to reduce the severity and frequency of motion sickness episodes, making it a beneficial natural remedy for individuals prone to this condition.
